_comment: Creation code of the PATCHED Zodiac Roles Modifier v2.1.1 mastercopy (src/OivInfraConstants.sol ROLES_MODIFIER_MASTERCOPY). Taken verbatim from its Ethereum mainnet deploy transaction 0xcd8636654fc597d47666c3753a98e2089cce57b0de135ab2bff600c96eaf0da0 (block 25302413), which called the EIP-2470 SingletonFactory's deploy(bytes,bytes32) with salt 0. CREATE2 through that factory is caller-independent, so replaying this blob lands the same address on any EVM chain -- that is how a chain missing the mastercopy (X Layer was, before this PR) is promoted without touching src/. The constructor args are the last three words (owner, avatar, target = address(1)), so the mastercopy is born neutered; proxies set their own. Pinned by OivChainDeploy.ROLES_MODIFIER_INIT_CODE_HASH and test/RolesMastercopySync.t.sol -- edit nothing here by hand.
